jobs.title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Role: What to expect Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production. 

 Role Responsibilities: What you will do Project & Program Delivery Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
 Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
 Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
 Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.
 
 Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
 Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
 Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.
 
 Stakeholder & Partner Management 
 Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
 Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
 Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
 Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.
 
 Operational Excellence Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
 Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.
 

 Role Requirements: What you need to succeed At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
 Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
 Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
 A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
 Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
 A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
 Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
 Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

 What You'll Need to Thrive

Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success

 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.

 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.

 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - CRM Sales

monday.com is pioneering a truly AI-native, agentic platform where intelligence is a core architectural component, not just an add-on. As an AI-first engineering organization, we've built a unified ecosystem where autonomous agents and workflows actively execute work on our users' behalf. From investing in an open MCP interface to orchestrating fleets of agents across the development lifecycle, we combine deep platform expertise with rapid iteration to solve high-magnitude challenges at scale. We aren't just adopting AI; we are redefining what product and engineering can be in an agentic world.
 
 monday CRM is one of the fastest-growing products in the monday.com portfolio, with tens of thousands of customers and strong momentum across segments. But the most interesting part isn't the scale: it's the transformation underway. We are actively evolving CRM into an AI-native product suite — one where intelligence is embedded across the full customer lifecycle, from acquisition to expansion. This is not a future roadmap; it's what we're building today.
 
 The CRM Sales group is at the forefront of this shift, enabling users to run their core CRM workflows through proactive Agentic experiences that help revenue teams close more deals — on Desktop and Mobile. This is a rare opportunity to join a group that is redefining how revenue teams operate in an Agentic-first era.
 
 About The Role 
 As a Senior Product Manager for the CRM Sales group, you will own product strategy and execution for a core pillar of our revenue platform. You will work at the intersection of AI-powered agentic experiences, deep CRM workflows, and enterprise-grade reliability — shaping how tens of thousands of revenue professionals work every day.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead Vision and Strategy 
 Define and own the product vision and roadmap for CRM Sales workflows, from pipeline management and deal execution to agentic automation.

 Align product strategy with company-wide goals for AI-driven revenue transformation, working closely with executive leadership and group stakeholders.

 Translate market trends, competitive signals, and customer insights into a differentiated product strategy for the CRM Sales group.

 
 Build Proactive Agentic Experiences 
 Own the ideation, prototyping, and delivery of AI-powered experiences that proactively surface insights, automate tasks, and guide revenue teams to close more deals.

 Collaborate with AI/ML and data teams to define the intelligence layer powering CRM recommendations, alerts, and automation.

 Identify the highest-leverage moments in the sales cycle where agentic assistance creates step-change value for users.

 
 Deliver and Scale Impact 
 Lead cross-functional teams spanning engineering, design, data science, analytics, and GTM to ship high-quality features efficiently.

 Define success metrics, instrument data collection, and use quantitative and qualitative signals to inform prioritisation and iteration.

 Ensure experiences work seamlessly across Desktop and Mobile, meeting the needs of reps in the field and in the office.

 
 Collaborate Across the Organization

 The Role

 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

 Du schlägst die Brücke zwischen echten Kundenbedürfnissen und starken technischen Lösungen?

 Klärung, Bewertung und Spezifikation fachlicher Anforderungen mit Stakeholdern sowie Sicherstellung der Beschreibung in Product Backlog Items unter Verwendung agiler Tools und Methoden, z. B. JIRA und SCRUM

 Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklungsteam, Kund:innen, Lieferant:innen und weiteren Stakeholdern in Bereichen wie Digitalisierung, Industrie 4.0 und vielen mehr

 Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang (mind. Bachelor)

 Erfahrung in der Rolle als Product Owner in der Software-Entwicklung

 Sehr gute Deutsch (C1-Level) und Englischkenntnisse!

 Scrum-Erfahrung

 Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

 Ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

 Im besten Fall schon zertifizierter Product Owner

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten

 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten

 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander

 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents

jobs.title: Head of Product (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ta mission 🎯 

 

 En tant que Head of Product, tu seras amené·e à guider nos clients (Decathlon, Carrefour, SeLoger, Chanel, Deezer, ...) dans leur transformation Produit et l’amélioration de leurs pratiques, soit en immersion au sein des équipes, soit en tant que Coach ou expert Produit. 

 

 Tu seras également le Manager / la Manageuse d'une équipe chez Thiga pour faire d'eux·elles les meilleur·e·s consultant·e·s & Product People possibles ! 

 

 Tu auras pour mission de : 

 - coacher et accompagner des équipes Produit chez ton client pour les faire gagner en maturité Product Management par la mise en place et la diffusion de bonnes pratiques ; 

 - évaluer la maturité produit d’équipes en place et proposer un plan d’action approprié pour optimiser l’organisation et les processus Produit ; 

 - cadrer et lancer un nouveau produit ou challenger et améliorer un produit existant ; 

 - déployer une vision long terme et coordonner la réalisation concrète de la roadmap ; 

 - encadrer ton équipe de Thiguys·girls avec du temps dédié pour permettre à tout Thiguy·girl d’être dans les meilleures conditions pour son développement professionnel et s’assurer de son épanouissement. 

 Compétences métier 🖇 

 Tu as déjà managé et, après une période d’onboarding, tu accompagneras et encadreras ton équipe de consultant·e·s Thiga.

 Tu établis la stratégie et la vision produit.

 Tu définis la roadmap et planifies les futures versions de ton produit avec une stratégie user-centric, orientée problèmes et outcomes.

 Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup.

 Tu sais interpréter les KPI mesurant la performance de ton produit et en déduire l’impact sur les utilisateurs. 

 Tu peux accompagner ton équipe dans la définition de ses OKR.

 Tu collabores avec des Product Designers pour concevoir l’expérience utilisateur et créer les interfaces web ou mobile, tu sais préparer des tests utilisateurs.

 Tu connais et utilises des techniques de priorisations (Rice, MoSCow, Kano…).

 Tu es à l'aise sur le Product Delivery et l'ensemble des rituels Agiles.

 Compétences relationnelles 🎙 

 La communication : tu donnes de la visibilité et t’exprimes de manière synthétique en étant également à l’écoute des autres.

 La diplomatie : tu sais défendre tes idées et tes convictions & gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.

 La curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Management.

 L’humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer.

 Shameless : tu parles français couramment tout en ayant un bon niveau d’anglais même si quand tu prononces beer, bird, bear ou beard ça se termine en quiproquo 🍺 🐥 🐻 🧔🏻

 Expériences 📇 

 Idéalement, tu as minimum 6 ans d’expérience dans une structure Produit (avec de la Product Discovery comme du Product Delivery).

 Tu as déjà managé (en direct) et / ou tu justifies d’au moins une expérience de Product Leader (Head of Product, Lead PM,...) dans ton parcours.

 Nous offrons 🎊 

 Un On-boarding d'une semaine pour rencontrer tes collègues dont 3 jours de formation pour bien démarrer.

 Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon le client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.

 Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Squad-building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).

 De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année et beaucoup de contenus pour te faire monter en compétences, notamment un programme de formation dédié aux Product Leaders avec des modules permettant de maîtriser toutes les facettes de ce rôle (coaching, OKR, organisation Produit, stratégie Produit).

 Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

 Les étapes 🎢 

 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.

 On te rencontre en personne ou par visio avec un·e dirigeant·e de l'équipe Thiga (Associé, Partner ou Principal) pour valider tes acquis.

 Une étude de cas avec deux consultant·e·s du niveau Manager ou Principal afin de confirmer ce que tu sais mettre en pratique.

 Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝

 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
About us 
 Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships
 Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support
 
 About the role
 Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users.

 Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless.

 Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue.

 Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 
 About You
 You've shipped products you can defend in detail. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you can name the user problem, what you owned personally vs. the team, and the measured outcome.

 You've built B2B SaaS for self-serve customers. You know the mechanics of self-serve growth, retention, and pricing, not just enterprise sales cycles.

 AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

 You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now.

 You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

 Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).
 
 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging
 We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.
 That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic & AI Platform
jobs.description:
About us 
 Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

 Role Summary
 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the AI platform every Photoroom product is built on. Our mission is that any team ships best-in-class GenAI visuals without needing a backend engineer: the primitives, the gateway and the no-code tooling turn adding an AI capability into a configuration step rather than an engineering project. On top of that sits the agentic layer — multi-step visual workflows that generate, check, reason, route and publish on their own. Working closely with engineers, ML researchers, and the product teams who ship on your platform, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.
 Location: Paris, (Hybrid)
 
 About the role
 Own the platform every AI feature runs through. Expand and improve our AI gateway, including safeguards, evals, cost and observability, giving teams the ability to ship with little to no code and build skills that we can ship directly to users.

 Build the agentic layer and Photoroom’s MCP. Visual agents that run multi-step flows: generate, QA, route, retry, publish, all unattended and at catalog scale.

 Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the problem, then partner with engineering and research to ship work that feels effortless — for the developers and PMs using the platform as much as for end users.

 Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

 Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue, and turn them into primitives other teams can reuse.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, such as adoption, latency, inference cost per successful generation, eval results. Form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 About You
 You've shipped products users love. 10+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you have solved a user’s problem and delivered business outcomes.

 You've built platform, infrastructure or developer-facing products. APIs, SDKs, internal platforms, ML infrastructure — products whose users are engineers.

 You've shipped something agentic or model-backed into production. You understand evals, guardrails, non-deterministic output, cost per call, and what breaks when a multi-step flow runs unattended a million times.

 AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

 You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now. On a platform, taste shows up in the interface you make other people build against.

 You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

 Benefits
 25 days + 8–10 RTT

 Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

 €1000 one-time home office grant OR €400 per month co-working space stipend

 €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

 Private health insurance

 Access to personalised mental health support, including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare

 Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

 Relocation support (up to 10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance

This is a growth role: you'll own the levers that turn sign-ups into retained subscribers, and the growth-led features that move them. From paywalls to pricing experiments and onboarding and discovery flows, you'll partner closely with User Acquisition on the handoff from paid to product, and with the core SMB product team on what gets built next.
 Location: Paris, we offer relocation support
 
 About the role
 Own a real slice of the growth funnel. Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end-to-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.

 Move the metric, not just the backlog. Run a high-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

 Find the insight, then build the feature. The best growth work is spotting why users drop off and shipping the change that fixes it. You'll do both.

 Work across web and mobile. Mobile and web funnels behave differently (App Store vs. card-on-file, push vs. email). You'll own both, and partner closely with the User Acquisition team on the handoff from paid to product.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 
 About You
 You've moved real numbers on a subscription product. Five to eight years as a PM, with concrete activation, monetization, or retention wins you can name with the KPI, the change, and the percentage impact, owned by you, not by a team you sat on.

 You've worked on something with recurring revenue. Whether B2B SaaS, B2C subscription, or B2B2C, as long as your work was tied directly to revenue your experience will give you a leg up. Pure marketplace or pure free-product backgrounds will struggle here.

 You know how SMB sellers buy. You understand how SMB e-commerce sellers discover, evaluate, and adopt utility SaaS, the kind of motion behind Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo, Stripe, Klarna, Gorgias, Recharge, Loop, Wix, or Squarespace.

 You're data-fluent. Comfortable with SQL and an analytics platform like Amplitude or Mixpanel; you build and interpret your own funnel without waiting for a data scientist, and you've shipped a high volume of A/B tests personally in the last 12 months.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

 Nice to have: experience on both web and mobile funnels; familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem (app store, connect flows, merchant personas) or a comparable e-commerce platform; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, enabling businesses to trust the intent behind their traffic—human, bot, or AI agent. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Bot And Agent Trust Management Q2 2026, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome's multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily, analyzing the intent of every session so only trusted traffic reaches your business — powering growth across your sites, apps, APIs, and MCP servers. Backed by a 24/7 SOC and expert threat researchers, DataDome stops 20k+ attacks every second. With 35+ global PoPs, and 80+ ready-made integrations, DataDome is a recognized Leader on G2 across several categories—delivering traffic you can trust.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to define and execute the strategy for the capabilities that power the DataDome customer lifecycle, from first-time setup and configuration through daily operation, expansion, and renewal. This role connects the customer-facing platform experience with the shared technical foundations and internal workflows required to make DataDome easier to adopt, operate, and scale. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security and Revenue Operations to create a coherent, secure, and increasingly automated platform experience for both customers and internal teams.

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape the next generation of the DataDome platform. You will help customers adopt and expand their use of DataDome, while building the shared capabilities, AI-enabled experiences, and internal tools that make the platform easier to use, scale, and operate.

Your mission

Lead the evolution of a seamless DataDome platform experience across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and integration through operation and expansion.

You will connect customer-facing experiences, shared technical foundations, and operational capabilities to make DataDome easier to adopt, administer, integrate, operate, and scale.

Customer experience and adoption

  • Set the vision and roadmap for DataDome’s shared platform and end-to-end customer journeys.
  • Lead the evolution of the unified Dashboard and common components, creating an intuitive and consistent experience across products.
  • Shape the workspaces, onboarding, product-led growth, and cross-product workflows that accelerate adoption and time-to-value.
  • Unify how customers access insights, configure protection, and manage their organization across DataDome.
  • Use AI to improve onboarding, self-service, customer insights, configuration, and expansion opportunities.

Shared foundations for trust, integration, and scale

  • Define the product direction for shared platform capabilities, including identity, authentication, user management, SSO, and RBAC.
  • Shape APIs, integrations, data ingress and egress, and developer-facing capabilities, including MCP and agent access.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture on a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient platform foundation.
  • Balance near-term customer needs with long-term platform leverage, resilience, and technical sustainability.

Commercial and operational scale

  • Own the product strategy for capabilities supporting customer provisioning, configuration, support, and operations.
  • Drive scalable workflows for entitlements, packaging, metering, billing, and account administration.
  • Use AI to automate internal workflows and help teams make faster, better-informed decisions.
  • Increase self-service and automation while reducing manual work, errors, and operational risk.

Strategy and outcomes

  • Turn customer, business, and technical needs into a focused, outcome-driven roadmap.
  • Make clear trade-offs across customer value, growth, platform leverage, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Align Product, Engineering, Design, Security, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Go-to-Market teams around priorities and outcomes.

What success looks like

  • Customers onboard faster, configure protection more easily, realize value sooner, and expand their use of DataDome.
  • Shared capabilities increase consistency, reuse, and delivery speed across Product and Engineering.
  • Self-service and automation improve the reliability and efficiency of provisioning, entitlements, metering, and billing.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (XDR & Exposure Management) - Security Solutions
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role
 
Elastic Security is looking for a Principal Product Manager to own XDR and the exposure and vulnerability capabilities converging with it. The best detection-and-response products are built on a clear read of how attacks actually unfold and where defenders actually lose time. That read is getting harder, not easier. The SOC's job now spans reactive detection and proactive exposure, and the two are collapsing into a single motion faster than most vendors can reorganize around it.
 
In this role you will own XDR end to end, from the detection-and-response core through the exposure and vulnerability work now converging with it. XDR is the center of gravity. Exposure and vulnerability management is the primary expansion, and the surrounding surfaces, attack surface and cloud posture, are signals you bring in to sharpen prioritization rather than products you build from scratch. You will be the person a CISO trusts to explain why one exposure matters more than a thousand others, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who turns a fast-moving market into a roadmap Elastic can win on. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and the Elastic Security Labs research team, on a platform whose unified data layer is the reason convergence can be native here instead of bolted on.
 
What You Will Be Doing
  • Own XDR strategy and delivery across cross-domain detection and response across endpoint, cloud, identity, and network. Work from correlation and incident building through response actions and the closed-loop automation that runs at machine speed without taking the analyst out of the loop.
  • Lead Elastic's XDR expansion into exposure and vulnerability management. This includes features like patch management, advanced device control, host firewall management, and remediation workflow. You'll also manage noise reduction to ensure these capabilities are used successfully.

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role
 
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.
 
In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.
 
What You Will Be Doing
  • Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”
  • Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join our mission 
 We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 
 We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.
 After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.
 Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.
 
 About the role 
 As a Technical Project Manager at Namespace, you'll drive technical projects from planning through execution, working closely with engineering teams to translate business goals into clear technical work, manage timelines and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned. You'll bring a strong technical background and experience working with software engineering and developer tools, allowing you to understand technical trade-offs, anticipate risks, and operate effectively alongside engineers.
 
 Our culture 
 We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.
  
 What you'll do 
 Translate high-level business goals into clear technical tasks and project plans for engineering teams

 Create and maintain project documentation, managing timelines, budgets, scope, resources, and day-to-day priorities

 Anticipate technical obstacles, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure appropriate testing and quality standards

 Keep engineering teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and company leadership aligned on progress, priorities, and roadblocks

 Manage technical vendors and suppliers as part of project delivery

 
 What we're looking for 
 Technical background with experience in software development, engineering, computer science, or a closely related field

 Proven experience managing technical projects, either in a dedicated technical project management role or as a significant part of an engineering or technical role

 Experience working closely with software engineering teams and a strong understanding of how engineering projects are planned, built, and shipped

 Familiarity with developer tools and modern software development workflows

 Ability to understand technical requirements, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks and translate them into clear project plans

 Strong ownership and ability to drive multiple stakeholders toward execution in a fast-moving environment

 
 You can expect: 
 Competitive salary and stock options

 Flexible working hours

 Market-leading parental leave

 
 Life at Namespace Labs: 
 We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

 We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

 We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

jobs.description:
Product Manager, Vertical Solutions
 Location: Lausanne; Cambridge Employment Type: Full time Location Type: Hybrid Department: Vertical Solutions
  
 About the role
 Neural Concept's Vertical Solutions team turns the most common engineering use cases into streamlined, production-grade workflows powered by leading AI technologies.
 As Product Manager or Solution Owner, you will own the product lifecycle for one of our vertical solutions end to end: from discovering customer needs to shipping AI-powered workflows that combine design, simulation, and data science/ML. You'll partner with industry-leading customers to translate real-world engineering problems into a product roadmap, and you'll work hands-on with AI-assisted development tools to move from concept to working prototype fast.
 This is a pivotal, cross-functional role: you'll work across product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to make sure what you build actually gets adopted and delivers value.
  
 What you will do
 Own the product roadmap for your vertical solution, from discovery through delivery and iteration.

 Run customer discovery: lead interviews, validate problem-solution fit, and turn insights into a clear product strategy and backlog.

 Define and prioritize requirements, write specs, and make the roadmap tradeoffs that keep the team focused on impact.

 Use AI-based development tools and hands-on prototyping (including scripting) to de-risk ideas quickly and get working solutions in front of customers sooner.

 Lead and collaborate closely with a cross-functional team of engineers (CAD/CAE/ML) to take solutions from prototype to production-ready.

 Track adoption and value delivery across customer projects in your vertical, and feed those insights back into the global product roadmap.

 Align vertical initiatives with overall company strategy.

 Who you are
 Proven product management experience: you've owned a product or product area end to end, from discovery to launch to iteration, ideally in an enterprise or technical B2B context.

 Hands-on with AI-based development: comfortable using AI coding/prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) and scripting (Python) to build and test ideas yourself rather than only writing specs for others.

 Background or exposure to consumer electronics, automotive, turbomachinery, aerospace, semiconductor manufacturing

 Familiarity with engineering software used in CAD/CAE/PLM workflows (e.g., SolidWorks, NX, ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus, Teamcenter, or similar).

 Exposure to end-to-end engineering design processes: requirements, concept, modeling and simulation, validation, release.

 Strong discovery and customer empathy skills: you can run a great customer interview, synthesize signal from noise, and translate it into a coherent product narrative.

 Pragmatic, impact-first problem solver: comfortable making tradeoffs, willing to challenge assumptions, and focused on outcomes over process.

 Comfortable operating cross-functionally with engineering, data science, and customer-facing teams, and able to influence without direct authority.

 Clear written and verbal communicator, able to align stakeholders across technical and business audiences.

 Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

 Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

 Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

 Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

 Balance life and work with a hybrid model (40% remote) and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Switzerland
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 Neural Concept is at the intersection of 3D deep learning and industrial engineering, building the tools that help the world's leading manufacturers design better products, faster. We're looking for a Product Manager who has lived the reality of engineering workflows inside large industrial organizations — and who is equally excited about where the industry is going. You understand what it feels like to wait on a simulation, to navigate a multi-year vehicle program, and to work within the constraints of a legacy toolchain. And you've seen — or been part of — what's possible when engineering meets modern AI and software. A formal "PM" title is not required; what matters is proven product thinking, sharp communication, and the humility to deeply understand problems that are different from your own experience. This is a rare role at the intersection of engineering credibility and product craft — and a unique opportunity to shape how AI transforms one of the most consequential domains in the world.
 
 What you will do 
 Engage deeply with customers — OEM engineering teams, simulation specialists, and program managers — to understand their day-to-day workflows, frustrations, and unmet needs, bringing genuine curiosity and listening skills to every interaction.

 Translate customer insight, market signals, and technical feasibility into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmap decisions, in close collaboration with Engineering and the leadership team.

 Own the product discovery process: design and run user research, synthesize findings across customer segments, and develop hypotheses that the team can build, test, and iterate on.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Application Engineering, and Marketing to ensure product decisions are grounded in real customer value and commercial viability.

 Represent the voice of industrial engineers internally — keeping the product technically credible, practically useful, and commercially sharp.

 Track trends in engineering software, advanced simulation, and AI tooling to identify whitespace, emerging use cases, and competitive positioning opportunities.

 
 Who you are 
 You have 3+ years of real engineering experience inside a large industrial organization — you know what it feels like to work on multi-year programs, navigate complex systems, and live with the constraints of real-world manufacturing or product development.

 You've also been exposed to a more modern environment — whether at a fast-moving hardware company, a next-gen engineering software startup, or a tech company embedded in industrial accounts — and you're energized by what AI and software can unlock for engineering teams.

 You bring genuine product instincts: you listen more than you talk, you're curious about problems that are different from your own engineering experience, and you know how to bring people along without having formal authority.

 You communicate with precision — in writing and in conversation — and you make prioritization decisions with structure and clear reasoning.

 You hold a degree in engineering or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree (MSc, PhD) is a plus.

 You are fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

 
 We know this combination of skills is rare. If you have one deep engineering experience — whether at a legacy industrial company or a modern company like Tesla or SpaceX — and strong product instincts, we want to hear from you. 
 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.
